artifacts.notes: Artifact pages 57-59 correspond to printed pp. 441-443 and were inspected. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The exact modern journal issue is publicly delivered by the responsible Holy See dicastery, but the issue contains modern editorial, liturgical, and scholarly material and no artifact-level redistribution license was located. Online official availability alone is not repository redistribution permission.

edition.authority: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
edition.notes: The issue carrying, at printed pp. 441-443, the Congregation's circular letter Prot. N. 467/05/L of 17 October 2006 to the presidents of the episcopal conferences on the vernacular rendering of pro multis in the formula of consecration of the chalice, under a Latin editorial preamble which states that the Italian version is to be held as the original.
